## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the reason for the change.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant focused tests passed locally and are listed below
- [ ] Full regression Evidence is attached when this is an integration, release, or high-risk gate
- [ ] `python -m compileall -q src tests`
- [ ] No credentials, private media, generated evidence, or personal data are included
- [ ] Rights, privacy, and destructive-operation boundaries were considered
- [ ] Documentation was updated when the change needs it
- [ ] If the Product version changed, `CHANGELOG.md` was updated and contains that release version
- [ ] Product version is consistent across package, GUI, and citation metadata

## Compatibility and risk

List affected platforms, providers, schemas, migrations, and rollback considerations.
